message:
This is a FreeType2 version with CPAL/COLR support. The OSS-Fuzz issue 42540604 is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1. Let me look at the CPAL/COLR code since that's the most recent work, and this is likely where the bug is.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=thought>The OSS-Fuzz issue 42540604 for freetype2 is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1. The most recent commits are about CPAL/COLR support. Let me look at the ttcolr.c and ttcpal.c files since these are the most recently modified and likely contain the vulnerability.</｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freetype2/src/sfnt/ | grep -i "colr\|cpal" && echo "---" && cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freetype2/src/sfnt/ttcolr.c</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
